name: @chewygumxx/skill-publishing-skills-to-npm
description: Packages a repository's agent skills as one npm package each and releases them per skill, with release-please and npm trusted publishing from GitHub Actions. Use when adding or renaming a skill package, wiring skills up for `skills experimental_sync`, setting up or debugging npm trusted publishing or provenance for skills, or cutting, bootstrapping or verifying a skill's release.
